methods.purpose: Describe exactly what period and behaviours are reconstructed and how daily/event information becomes outputs.
methods.required_specification_fields: reference/recall window; temporal anchors; event/calendar aids; reconstructed unit; respondent/perspective; administration mode; input variables; output variables; aggregation rule
methods.evidence_interpretation_fields: repeatability; recall bias; comparison/reference source; missing-day handling; burden
methods.public_display_principle: Show procedure/configuration before evidence; do not imply one scale total.
methods.production_schema_action: Add type-specific fields after all five public approaches are calibrated.

methods.calibration_exemplar: Population-level attributable-fraction estimation of gambling-related harm costs
methods.purpose: Make the estimand, counterfactual and economic assumptions explicit enough to interpret attributable/excess burden estimates.
methods.required_specification_fields: estimand/output; causal/associational status; comparator/counterfactual; exposure definition; effect/risk input; population denominator; perspective; cost domains; price year/currency; time horizon; valuation method; uncertainty/sensitivity; overlap/double-counting rule
methods.evidence_interpretation_fields: causal assumptions; parameter provenance; uncertainty propagation; sensitivity; omitted harms/transfers; comparability
methods.public_display_principle: Name the exact output; never collapse causal PAF, excess cases and monetised excess cost into one label.
methods.production_schema_action: Add type-specific fields after all five public approaches are calibrated.

methods.purpose: Represent each VAS application as a configured elicitation procedure rather than a universal fixed instrument.
methods.required_specification_fields: exact prompt/construct; lower/upper anchors; scale/line length and orientation; visible numeric labels; reference window; device/interface; initial marker/default; response capture; score transformation
methods.evidence_interpretation_fields: format comparability; reliability context; electronic migration; change interpretation; missingness/burden
methods.public_display_principle: Generic VAS stays CONFIGURABLE; evidence for one construct/application does not validate all VAS uses.
methods.production_schema_action: Add reusable configuration block after all five public approaches are calibrated.

methods.purpose: Show package composition and evidence by component, version and assessment time point.
methods.required_specification_fields: package version; component/form; time point; respondent; administration mode; recall/window; component output; scoring; service/process data element; current/manual status
methods.evidence_interpretation_fields: which component/property was evaluated; sample/cohort; missing/proxy data; package-level versus component-level evidence
methods.public_display_principle: Never publish a single package coefficient when evidence is component/time-point specific.
methods.production_schema_action: Add component × version × time-point manifest after all five public approaches are calibrated.

methods.purpose: Expose the relational design choices that determine what a network measure means and whether results are comparable.
methods.required_specification_fields: actor/node set; network boundary; tie definition/semantics; directed/undirected; binary/weighted; ego/whole-network; temporal window/dynamic design; nomination limits; missingness/reconciliation; transformations; metric definition/normalisation; software/code/version
methods.evidence_interpretation_fields: relationship-report reliability; ascertainment/sampling; missing ties; metric sensitivity; temporal aggregation; causal/confounding limits; reproducibility; confidentiality/burden
methods.public_display_principle: Construct target remains social-network structure; configuration choices and application constructs are separate.
methods.production_schema_action: Add relational specification block after all five public approaches are calibrated.

indicators.purpose: Make accounting conventions explicit so numerically similar financial indicators are not treated as interchangeable.
indicators.required_specification_fields: formula/estimand; sign convention; currency/price basis; observation window; unit/aggregation; products/accounts covered; data source; bonuses/free bets; cash-outs; refunds/reversals; transfers; unsettled bets; balances
indicators.evidence_interpretation_fields: self-report/record agreement; recall/estimation bias; missing coverage; skew/outliers; source comparability; relationship to harm/affordability
indicators.public_display_principle: Name the financial quantity exactly; expenditure/loss is not automatically financial harm, affordability or disorder.
indicators.production_schema_action: Add type-specific fields after all five public approaches are calibrated.

indicators.purpose: Make the denominator, episode and exit rules explicit before comparing rates across services.
indicators.required_specification_fields: eligible cohort; treatment-start/engagement rule; expected endpoint; numerator/dropout definition; patient/service initiation; reporting period; episode construction; censoring; transfers; planned early completion; pauses/re-entry; deaths; administrative discharge; lost follow-up
indicators.evidence_interpretation_fields: coding completeness/reliability; denominator sensitivity; censoring; cross-service comparability; reason-for-exit uncertainty
indicators.public_display_principle: A dropout rate is a process indicator; lower is not automatically better care and the rate alone does not explain why people leave.
indicators.production_schema_action: Add type-specific fields after all five public approaches are calibrated.

indicators.purpose: Expose transaction coverage and merchant-classification choices that determine the observed outflow.
indicators.required_specification_fields: observation window; gross/net direction; bank/provider coverage; connected-account coverage; merchant mapping/version; intermediaries; card/account types; currency; posting date; refunds/reversals; deduplication; audit/error checks; cash/other-channel omissions
indicators.evidence_interpretation_fields: classification error; missing merchants/accounts; mapping drift; reproducibility; cross-provider comparability; distinction from net deposits/loss/harm
indicators.public_display_principle: Show gross merchant outflow as its own estimand; do not collapse it with debit-minus-credit net deposits.
indicators.production_schema_action: Add transactional-indicator manifest after all five public approaches are calibrated.

indicators.purpose: Make edition, geography and linkage choices explicit for area-context indicators.
indicators.required_specification_fields: edition/release; component/domain identity; input-data years; geography level/code/vintage; lookup/remapping version; score/rank/decile direction; national/local/population grouping; larger-area aggregation
indicators.evidence_interpretation_fields: edition comparability; boundary change; ecological interpretation; individual-versus-area distinction; covariate/domain overlap
indicators.public_display_principle: Present IMD as relative area deprivation, not an individual socioeconomic score.
indicators.production_schema_action: Add area-indicator manifest after all five public approaches are calibrated.

indicators.purpose: Expose the utility, time, comparator and modelling assumptions needed to interpret a QALY quantity.
indicators.required_specification_fields: utility instrument/version; value set/population; measurement schedule; interpolation; survival/death handling; output type; comparator/sign; horizon; discounting; baseline adjustment; missing-data method; observed versus modelled/projected/attributed status
indicators.evidence_interpretation_fields: utility-input comparability; uncertainty/sensitivity; mortality; negative values; attribution/counterfactual assumptions; observed versus modelled QALYs
indicators.public_display_principle: Separate QALY from the utility instrument/value set used as input; different utility systems are not automatically interchangeable.
indicators.production_schema_action: Add health-economic metric manifest after all five public approaches are calibrated.

qualitative.purpose: Describe the local MSC implementation without implying that generic MSC guidance defines a fixed gambling-recovery protocol.
qualitative.required_specification_fields: method label; application/domain; story prompt(s); reporting period; recruitment/sampling; storyteller perspective; panel composition; selection procedure; selection reasons; negative/disconfirming stories; verification/member checking; consent/confidentiality; translation; feedback cycle; reporting/use
qualitative.trustworthiness_interpretation_fields: voice/representation; selection bias; reflexivity; transparency; verification; inclusion/equity; burden; triangulation; transferability
qualitative.public_display_principle: Public label should foreground Most Significant Change (MSC); recovery narrative should be shown as the configured application unless a fixed recovery protocol is later sourced.
qualitative.production_schema_action: Add narrative-procedure manifest after Website V3 adjudication.

qualitative.purpose: Expose who participated, how the model was elicited and revised, and what epistemic status the resulting model has.
qualitative.required_specification_fields: stakeholder groups; recruitment; absent voices; facilitator/modeller roles; script/exercise/version; session count/duration; materials/software; data capture; model/output type; disagreement handling; revision/validation cycle; documentation/audit trail; later empirical/simulation testing
qualitative.trustworthiness_interpretation_fields: participation/inclusion; power; facilitation dependence; transparency; credibility; reproducibility/transferability; feasibility/resources; distinction between shared hypothesis and empirical causal validation
qualitative.public_display_principle: Show the generated map/model as a documented participatory output, not as a validated causal model merely because participants agreed.
qualitative.production_schema_action: Add participatory-method configuration/audit manifest after Website V3 adjudication.

qualitative.purpose: Make the case boundary, evidence trail and economic attribution transparent enough to distinguish narrative, observed use and modelled costs.
qualitative.required_specification_fields: case-selection rationale; respondent perspectives; life-course/time boundary; narrative source; record/collateral sources; conflicting-account reconciliation; observed resource quantities; imputed quantities; cost categories; valuation source; currency/price year; perspective; horizon; discounting; transfers/double counting; attribution rule; counterfactual/modelled elements; missing/unobservable costs
qualitative.trustworthiness_interpretation_fields: triangulation; recall/reconstruction bias; researcher judgement; attribution uncertainty; confidentiality/identifiability; burden; transferability; non-generalisation from individual case to population burden
qualitative.public_display_principle: Display a timeline/evidence/cost ledger; individual case estimates are illustrative/analytic cases, not population averages or causal burden estimates.
qualitative.production_schema_action: Add case/timeline/cost-provenance manifest after Website V3 adjudication.
